6.47 rsFieldInPageSectionExpression
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsFieldInPageSectionExpression is a critical error that will occur if an expression within a PageSection,
PageHeaderFooter, or PageFooter element contains a reference to a Field via the Fields global
collection.
